entities.title: Native interop
entities.summary: Explicit adapters between UTV values and Rust's own time types: std's SystemTime always, chrono's types behind the cargo feature chrono.
entities.purpose: Brings a native value into UTV and back out under the rules of docs/everyday-api.md, Native interop: the caller names the intent, nothing tied to the host's zone is accepted, and a conversion back to native that would lose something is refused. mod.rs holds the SystemTime adapters and the module utv::interop; chrono.rs (utv::interop::chrono) holds the JSON-layer functions for chrono and the From/TryFrom impls between chrono's types and the typed values.
boundaries: Never reads the clock: a reading is always an argument.
Converts; it does no arithmetic. The values it makes are checked by the JSON layer's readers (src/model.rs) and the typed layer.
chrono.rs compiles only with the cargo feature chrono (#[cfg(feature = "chrono")] in mod.rs).
